name: Dumbbell Forearm Pronation
steps: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs and your hands beyond your knees, palms up around horizontal dumbbell handles.
Grip each handle off center so the longer lever is on your thumb side and rotate your forearms inward until your thumbs point up.
Slowly lower the thumb ends outward until your palms face up again.
tips: Keep your elbows supported and your wrists straight.
Turn the dumbbell smoothly and control its return without lifting your forearm.
